source_title: UNESCO Guidance for generative AI in education and research
direct_observation: GenAI is outpacing regulation and raises privacy safety copyright bias and human-agency concerns requiring age-appropriate pedagogical validation
closed_stage: governance risk and human-centred design boundary
missing_stage: named classroom learning teacher workload local-language quality sustained use and child outcomes
next_test: pilot a validated use case with teacher and learner co-design and independent outcome measures

unit_or_scope: teachers learners schools and education systems
direct_observation: GenAI may improve task performance without learning gains when cognitive work is outsourced while pedagogical intent and teacher co-design can support learning
closed_stage: task-performance versus learning distinction and teacher-agency mechanism
missing_stage: independent retention transfer workload and distributional effects
next_test: compare with and without AI access and measure teacher mediation workload and learning transfer

source_title: UNICEF Guidance on AI and Children 3.0
unit_or_scope: children families schools and AI providers
direct_observation: Child-centred AI requires safety privacy fairness transparency inclusion best interests skills and accountability and education use should be evidence-based
missing_stage: implementation remedy consent learning and wellbeing outcomes
next_test: audit one school procurement and trace consent data use incidents remedy and outcomes

source_title: UNESCO multilingual education and language inclusion evidence
direct_observation: A large share of learners lack education in a language they understand and dominant-language AI can deepen linguistic and cultural exclusion
missing_stage: named language performance teacher correction mother-tongue learning transmission and legitimacy
next_test: test AI-assisted learning across dominant and minority languages with local teacher and family review

source_title: World Bank Nigeria AI tutoring evaluation
unit_or_scope: first-year senior secondary students in Nigeria
direct_observation: One six-week GPT-4 tutoring intervention reported positive English and AI or digital-skills assessment effects while related teacher studies remain under evaluation
closed_stage: short-term bounded intervention result in one setting
missing_stage: persistence transfer cost teacher mediation language fit safety and replication
next_test: replicate with longer follow-up independent assessment teacher workload and non-user comparison

source_title: U.S. Department of Education responsible-use guidance
unit_or_scope: schools educators students families education technology vendors and student data
direct_observation: The Department calls for educator-led ethical accessible transparent and student-data-protective use and asks schools what problem a tool solves for whom for how long and what evidence demonstrates learning
missing_stage: enforcement actual decisions independent outcomes teacher voice and subgroup equity
next_test: trace one procurement decision through implementation evidence and removal or continuation

source_title: UK Department for Education generative-AI guidance
unit_or_scope: education workforce learners schools and AI tools in England
direct_observation: UK guidance says AI may reduce administrative burden but evidence on learner development educational outcomes and child safety remains limited and warns about teacher relationship bias and misinformation
missing_stage: named classroom outcomes workload redistribution language quality safety and sustained use
next_test: compare an adopted use case with independent learning teacher workload and safety evidence

source_title: U.S. Student Privacy Policy Office AI tutoring and AI grading scenarios
unit_or_scope: K-12 district AI tutoring platform student data teachers parents grades and AI feedback
direct_observation: Federal training scenarios describe initial grade and engagement gains followed by a tutoring-platform data leak or unexplained AI grading failures that fracture trust
closed_stage: concrete privacy assessment-integrity and trust mechanisms
missing_stage: incident prevalence legal remedy family notification learning loss and correction
next_test: simulate or audit a district tool from procurement data flow error detection family notice and remedy

source_title: UNESCO media and information literacy in AI-mediated environments
unit_or_scope: young people educators learners AI-generated information and classroom practice
direct_observation: UNESCO's 2026 module centers critical thinking and human agency and teaches learners to question generated information and understand AI power while reporting widespread youth AI use
missing_stage: measured verification independent learning teacher practice language inclusion and long-term cognition
next_test: measure pre/post verification agency and learning across language and resource contexts
